University Leadership

Supporting our mission and community.

  • University Leadership

Key Websites

The University president and provost lead Northwestern, which is governed by a Board of Trustees.

Office of the President

Mung Chiang is serving as Northwestern University's 18th President.

Office of the Provost

The provost is the University's chief academic officer, overseeing educational priorities and initiatives.

Board of Trustees

The Board of Trustees establishes policies for University governance and is responsible for general oversight of the management of the institution.

Leadership Notes

Official statements, messages and announcements to the Northwestern community from Northwestern University leaders.

Senior Administrators

These administrators lead key offices that support the University's mission.


  • President

  • Provost

  • Vice President and Secretary to the Board of Trustees

  • Associate Vice President for Civil Rights and Title IX Compliance

  • Vice President for Student Affairs

  • Interim Vice President for Research

  • Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

  • Vice President and Chief Investment Officer

  • Vice President and Chief Operating Officer

  • Vice President for Athletic Strategy

  • Vice President and General Counsel

  • Vice President for International Relations

  • Interim Vice President for Human Resources and Chief Human Resources Officer

  • Combe Family Vice President for Athletics and Recreation

  • Vice President and Dean of Enrollment

  • Special Assistant to the President for Government Relations

  • Vice President for Alumni Relations and Development

  • Vice President for Medical Affairs and Dean of Feinberg School of Medicine

  • Vice President for Technology and Chief Information Officer

  • Vice President for Global Marketing and Communications
